lines.t: You're the one I want to think of most.
You're the one I want to put first.
Even though it's hard sometimes, I feel You near.
Helping me move forward,
Putting away every fear.
When my strength is gone
And I can't find my way
You're the arms I run to
You're the hope that makes me stay
You're my heart's desire, the name my soul sings
You are the One I look to when I need help most
You are the fire, fueling my flickering flame
You are the Shepherd that guides me when I'm lost
YahuShua, You are what I need
When I am troubled,
You turn my sorrow into song.
In Your embrace is where I belong.
And every moment, every day,
When I think of You,
I find a thousand reasons to praise.
When sorrow finds me,
When troubled thoughts come my way.
I remember You and think,
You're enough in every way.
You're my heart's desire, the name my soul sings
You are the One I look to when I need help most
You are the fire, fueling my flickering flame
You are the Shepherd that guides me home when I'm lost
YahuShua, You are what I need
Nothing else can satisfy
This longing deep within my life
You are my joy, my peace, my song
In Your love is where I belong
And when the world is closing in
Your love reminds me once again
I'm never walking on my own
You are my heart, You are my home
You are my joy,
You are my peace,
You are the love that lives in me.
You are my light,
You are my song.
YahuShua, to You I belong.
You're my heart's desire, the name my soul sings
You are the One I look to when I need help most
You are the fire, fueling my flickering flame
You are the Shepherd that guides me home when I'm lost
YahuShua, You are what I need
YahuShua...
You are what I need
You're my heart's desire
Forever, You are all I need.
